paragraphs.source_en: Most likely, the budget has some padding in anticipation of this kind of eventuality. Startups are di erent: too much budget is as harmful as too little —as countless dot-com failures can attest—and startups are extremely sensitive to midcourse budgetary changes. It is extremely rare for a stand-alone startup company to lose 10 percent of its cash on hand suddenly. In a large number of cases, this would be a fatal blow, as independent startups are run with little margin for error. Thus, startups are both easier and more demanding to run than traditional divisions: they require much less capital overall, but that capital must be absolutely secure from tampering. Independent Development Authority Startup teams need complete autonomy to develop and market new products within their limited mandate.
